qa_pairs.instruction: Which Oracle E-Business Suite versions are supported by the Oracle EBS Suite driver?
qa_pairs.output: The Oracle EBS Suite driver supports Oracle E-Business Suite version 12.1.1 and any later releases. The most recent version that is officially supported is Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2.6.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the version compatibility of the Oracle EBS Suite driver for Oracle E-Business Suite.
qa_pairs.output: The Oracle EBS Suite driver works with Oracle E-Business Suite versions 12.1.1 onward, with the latest officially supported release being 12.2.6.
